{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Model Edit → `uFitPlate` (also on the Comma ribbon tab, Model Edit block)
{{% /callout %}}

Fits ContourPlate edges and manual BentPlate leg edges to a face, a three-point plane or a line.

**How to use:**

1.  Select the plates, choose the reference, and set the options.
2.  Click **Apply**, pick the reference, then pick an edge when *Edge selection* is set to pick one.
3.  Repeat until <kbd>Esc</kbd>.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Reference** | Face, Plane 3 points (pick exactly three points), Line, or Line 2 points. |
| **Gap** | Signed, in mm. Metric or imperial per XS\_IMPERIAL\_INPUT when the dialog opens; blank keeps the last gap. |
| **Edge selection** | Automatic, or Pick edge (a native line pick). |
| **Side** | Nearest keeps the contour side closest to the reference; Farthest keeps the opposite side. Minimize/Maximize chooses between the fitted top and bottom surface areas. |
| **Fit all** | Controls picked-line matches and multi-leg ambiguity. For an automatic BentPlate Plane fit, Yes selects independently on each current leg; No selects one global group. Automatic ContourPlate and automatic BentPlate Line fits ignore it. |

The last five applied gaps are kept for this tool during the current Tekla session.

**More details:**

-   Gap is signed in millimetres.
-   Fit all controls picked-line matches and multi-leg ambiguity.
-   Gap accepts metric arithmetic or imperial feet/inch fractions according to XS\_IMPERIAL\_INPUT at dialog opening.
-   Reopen after changing units.
-   Standard attributes are loaded and normalized on opening.
